data.name: Bane and Valor
data.detailed_description:
Fight your way through enemies, solve quests and defeat bosses

Enter different levels, each with their own enemies, a big variety of quests and a final boss awaiting you at the end of each level. Find secrets to enter hidden dungeons and solve their mystery. If you manage to defeat the final boss the hard mode awaits you increasing the difficulty not only with stats but also with new
mechanics.

Unlock a big variety of heroes

Choose one of the starter heroes, play through levels and complete tasks to unlock even more heroes! Not a fan of your Cryomancer anymore? Dont worry about it, your level is bound to your equipment, quickly move it to another hero without having to redo everything again.

Farm new gear, find your perfect build

With over 10 different stats and countless combinations you can find the perfect fit for your hero. Want to go attack speed on your Berserk? Go for it or maybe mix in some cooldown reduction or life steal as well. Find the perfect build for every hero. Collect artifacts to unlock more effects that fit your playstyle and use talents to directly adjust your abilities!

Take care of your camp

Find friendly NPCs for your camp and help them with their tasks. This way they will be able to offer great value to you. And who knows, maybe you will even be able
to start your Legendary Journey.

Features

- A variety of playable heroes each with their own skill set

- Talents for every hero's ability to further personalize gameplay

- A variety of different stats for equipment to craft the perfect build for every hero

- Hero level is based on your equipment, switch your hero at any time, no boring grind

- 8 Maps each with 3 interesting quests and a final boss fight with unique mechanics

- A big variety of different enemies to keep the experience fresh

- Hidden dungeons that wait to be explored

- A lobby for you to interact with NPCs and prepare for the next run

- Lots of secrets to reward curious players

- Play through Story Mode to unlock Hard Mode for new challenges

data.short_description: Bane and Valor is a hero-based top-down action-RPG that offers tons of build variety to let you play the way YOU want. Find your favorite hero, craft the perfect build, solve quests and defeat mighty bosses in this medievil fantasy world.
